concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:FR-009 Acceptance Scenario 1 / FR-018
concerns.text: No task implements the user-facing CSV composition input path. Spec Acceptance Scenario 1 ('Given a valid CSV file containing alloy compositions... run the pipeline with default settings') and FR-018's explicit inclusion of `hea_composition.schema.yaml` in the contract-validation list have no covering task: every task ingests data only via the Materials Project API (T001/T008). Add a task (or extend T003) that accepts a user CSV, validates it against `contracts/hea_composition.schema.yaml`, and exercises the FR-009 missing-fraction abort on that path.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 and coverage table row 'FR-015/FR-022/FR-023 (power analysis)'
concerns.text: T004 is tagged '(FR-015, FR-022, FR-023)' and the coverage table maps FR-023 to T004, but FR-023 is the requirement to document measurement protocols/processing-condition differences between primary and external datasets — it is actually covered by T008. The power-analysis abort behavior is not FR-023. Fix the tag to avoid a misleading traceability mapping (FR-023 remains covered, so this is a tag correction, not a missing task).

Plan Phase 0 requires validating `requirements.txt` against `contracts/requirements.schema.yaml`, but no task performs this and the contract does not exist in the data model. Either add a pinned-dependencies task or note in the Revision Behavior section that Phase 0's requirements-validation step is superseded (the constitution's Reproducibility Requirements still demand a pinned requirements.txt — currently no task creates one).
